headline: Fronts Stir Across Weathered Expanse and Shelf
war_summary: The latest returns show the battle lines still concentrated in a handful of hard-fought regions, with Weathered ExpanseHex leading the ledger. It recorded 64 strategic-base events in the past day, including six in the latest two hours, and remains divided five Warden to four Colonial bases; casualty rates for both sides are accelerating. StlicanShelfHex has edged up to 24 daily events, with six in six hours and none in the latest two, while its ownership stands five Colonial to four Warden. MooringCountyHex has quickened from 12 to 14 daily events and recorded two in six hours, holding eleven Warden and one Colonial base. CallahansPassageHex has regained some motion, posting two events in two hours despite remaining at 29 for the day. FishermansRowHex stays unsettled at 33 daily events but has gone quiet in the latest two hours. NevishLineHex retains five daily events and three in six hours, while LinnMercyHex remains quieter at three. The sharpest immediate ownership-change signals therefore lie in Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, Mooring County, and Callahan’s Passage.
